solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: 5 to 4 on a winner that's lively

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
IV is the Roman numeral for four
an ace is a winning serve or a champion

explanation.surface: A punter backs a horse at odds of five to four on and feels upbeat.
explanation.walkthrough: The betting odds are a smokescreen: the numbers are Roman numerals put side by side. VIVACE is a musical direction meaning brisk.
explanation.definitionFit: Vivace is the Italian tempo marking asking players to perform in a brisk, spirited way.

clue.text: State tax one can put an end to

parts.note: VAT is value added tax, the UK sales tax
I is the Roman numeral for one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tax that a single person can abolish.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is value added tax, Britain's sales tax. The rest of the clue reads as a picture of abolition while simply supplying I and CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Vatican City is a sovereign country, the smallest independent nation in the world.

clue.text: A good watch will enable one to practice this

definitions.text: A good watch will enable one to practice this

parts.words: A good watch will enable one to practice this
parts.note: a watch here is the act of keeping guard, not a timepiece, and staying alert is what good guarding demands

explanation.walkthrough: A watch suggests a wristwatch and punctuality, but it is the sentry's watch: keeping guard is the practice of wakeful alertness.
explanation.definitionFit: Careful watchfulness for danger is exactly what a lookout keeping guard exercises.

clue.text: Where the batsman stands about in case

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece sits inside the box given by the other

parts.note: taken as written
RE is a Latin-derived word meaning concerning or about

explanation.surface: A cricketer stands around ready in case something happens.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the CREASE is the white line where the batsman takes guard.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket the batting crease is the marked line at which a batsman takes their stance.

clue.text: Developing and going round topless

indicators.note: without its top means the first letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: something revolving is going round and round

explanation.surface: Someone changing and spinning about with no top on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' removes R, the first letter of REVOLVING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something evolving is gradually growing and changing, which is what developing means.

clue.text: Instrument that has an appalling sound

indicators.note: the word sound tells us the answer is pronounced like a synonym from the clue

parts.note: vile means appalling or disgusting

explanation.surface: A musical instrument that makes a dreadful noise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like part of the picture of a screeching instrument but signals a homophone of VILE.
explanation.definitionFit: The viol is a bowed stringed instrument of the Renaissance and Baroque, forerunner of the violin family.

clue.text: When women propose to break with tradition

definitions.text: When women propose to break with tradition

parts.words: When women propose to break with tradition
parts.note: by old custom a woman may propose marriage on 29 February, a day that comes once every four years

explanation.walkthrough: The surface sounds like social reform, but it points to the custom that women may propose on 29 February.
explanation.definitionFit: Tradition allows women to propose marriage on the extra February day that the four-yearly calendar adds.

clue.text: Country needs aid in getting into shape

indicators.note: getting into shape suggests the letters being pulled into a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nation needs foreign aid to get itself into good order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting into shape' rearranges AID IN.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a large nation in South Asia, so a straightforward example of a country.

clue.text: Throttle great to adjust

indicators.note: to adjust is to alter, so these letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to change the setting of a great engine's throttle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Throttle' sounds like an engine control, but it is the verb to strangle; 'adjust' rearranges GREAT TO.
explanation.definitionFit: To garotte someone is to strangle them with a cord, which is to choke or throttle.

clue.text: Gadget wrongly labelled

indicators.note: wrongly means the letters are set out incorrectly, so they are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A device carries the wrong label.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tagged has had a tag, a small identifying label, attached to it.

clue.text: Near-cold stew found in the kitchen

indicators.note: to stew is to cook ingredients together until they mix, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A lukewarm casserole sitting in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' looks like a noun in the kitchen picture but is the verb rearranging NEAR-COLD; the definition is a loose description of a utensil.
explanation.definitionFit: A colander, a perforated bowl for draining food, is a standard utensil kept among kitchen equipment.

clue.text: Virginia takes a different train for variety

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

indicators.note: different means changed, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone from Virginia catches another train for a change of scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' looks like the railway in the picture, but 'different' tells us to rearrange it; 'takes a' just links the state to what follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A variant is a different form or version of something, a variety of it.

clue.text: Firm rule about the French salad

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
LES is French for the in the plural
a law is a rule

explanation.surface: A company regulation concerning French people.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'about' as concerning: a firm's rule about the French. The pieces simply run in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Coleslaw is a dish of shredded raw cabbage in dressing, a type of salad.

clue.text: One ruling despot starts to turn nasty

indicators.note: starts points to the opening letter of the following word
to turn here means to change around, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A ruling tyrant's beginnings in becoming cruel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts' gives D from 'despot', and 'to turn' rearranges NASTY to YNAST.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynast is a hereditary ruler, a member of a ruling dynasty.

clue.text: Guided a horse holding half the rein

indicators.note: holding means one piece clasps the other within it

parts.note: a steed is a horse

indicators.note: half the word gives its first two letters

explanation.surface: A rider steered a horse with only half the rein.
explanation.walkthrough: The rider picture makes 'rein' look like tack, but 'half' keeps only its first two letters, which 'holding' places in the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To have steered something is to have directed its course, that is, guided it.

clue.text: Woman in evening dress that's figure revealing

indicators.note: revealing means the letters are exposed within the run of words

explanation.surface: A woman in a body-hugging evening gown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'figure' wants to be her shapely body; it means a number. 'revealing' shows the letters spanning 'woman in evening'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine is a number, and a number written down is a figure.

clue.text: Asian navies meet at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fleets from several countries encounter one another on the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' fits the naval picture but rearranges NAVIES MEET.
explanation.definitionFit: A Vietnamese person comes from Vietnam, a country in Asia, so is Asian.

clue.text: Bringing out a note-case

parts.note: E is one of the musical notes
the vocative is the grammatical case used to address someone

explanation.surface: Taking out a wallet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note-case' looks like a wallet for banknotes, but it splits into a musical note and a grammatical case.
explanation.definitionFit: Something evocative brings out memories or feelings, calling them forth in the mind.

clue.text: The culprit's proposal about the outcome

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: an offer is a proposal
the end of something is its outcome

explanation.surface: The guilty party suggests something concerning the result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning' in the surface, but here it means surrounding; the possessive 's on 'culprit' is just 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is a person who has committed the wrong, which is what a culprit is.

clue.text: Market researcher on camera

parts.note: a market researcher seeks out opinions, and a camera has a part for finding the view to shoot

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a pollster filmed for television; the camera part is the eyepiece used to frame the shot.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera's eyepiece used to frame the picture is literally something that finds views.

clue.text: Meat stewed in ovens

indicators.note: stewed means cooked into a mixture, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Meat being slowly cooked in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stewed' fits the cooking picture but rearranges IN OVENS.
explanation.definitionFit: Venison is the meat of deer, eaten as game.

clue.text: Go round to drop article that's invalid

indicators.note: to drop means a piece is left out of the word

parts.note: to avoid something is to go round it
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Walk around rather than discard an item that does not count.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to drop' removes the article A from AVOID.
explanation.definitionFit: A void contract or result is legally null, with no force, so invalid.

clue.text: Furniture employed off stage

definitions.meaning: a sideboard with shelves for dishes is a piece of furniture
in the theatre a person hired backstage helps actors into their costumes

explanation.walkthrough: Both senses fit: a kitchen sideboard, and the backstage helper who gets actors into costume.
explanation.definitionFit: A dresser is both a kitchen cupboard with shelves and a theatre wardrobe assistant working in the wings.

clue.text: City could be very nice if it contained a miniature railway

indicators.note: the clue says the city would be the phrase if it held the railway, so taking those letters out leaves the city

parts.note: RY is a short abbreviation for railway, so a miniature railway

explanation.surface: A city would be lovely with a little toy railway.
explanation.walkthrough: Put RY into the city's name and you get VERY NICE, so take RY from 'very nice'.
explanation.definitionFit: Venice is the Italian city built on canals in a lagoon.

clue.text: A struggle between northern and southern sea forces

indicators.note: between means set inside, with one piece on each side

parts.note: to vie is to struggle or compete

explanation.surface: A conflict between north and south fought by the fleets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'between' sets A and VIE between N and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Navies are a nation's fighting ships and crews, its forces at sea.

clue.text: Aids to circulation

parts.note: circulation suggests newspaper sales or traffic flow, but here it is the movement of blood around the body

explanation.walkthrough: 'circulation' suggests newspaper sales; it is blood flow, helped by the vessels carrying blood back to the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: These blood vessels carry blood back to the heart, so they help the body's circulation.

clue.text: Think a great deal of, but rate even better

indicators.note: better means improve or alter, so the letters are remade in another order

explanation.surface: Hold someone in high regard, but rate them still higher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' reads as comparison but rearranges RATE EVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: To venerate someone is to hold them in deep respect, thinking very highly of them.

clue.text: Broadcast live coverage

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Live television coverage of an event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coverage' wants to be news reporting; it is something that covers.
explanation.definitionFit: A veil is a piece of fabric that covers the face, a form of covering.

clue.text: There's a certain wildness in such devious dealings

indicators.note: a certain amount of wildness suggests these letters run wild and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fraudulent dealings have a reckless streak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wildness' is both the fodder and, in sense, the hint to rearrange it: its letters give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Swindles are frauds and cheats, which is what devious dealings amount to.

clue.text: Calls after five, is to take a seat inside

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

indicators.note: inside means one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: to sit is to take a seat

explanation.surface: Someone drops round after five o'clock and is invited to sit down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take a seat' is a phrase for one verb, and 'inside' places it within the clue's own 'is', with the Roman five in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Visits are social calls paid to someone's home.

clue.text: Breathing spaces?

parts.note: a breathing space is usually a rest, but read literally it is a passage for air in the nose

explanation.walkthrough: A breathing space usually means a pause; here it is literal, the openings air passes through.
explanation.definitionFit: The openings of the nose are the spaces through which a person breathes.

clue.text: Wooden-faced beauty

parts.note: wooden-faced suggests an expressionless person, but here it is a fine thin layer of wood on a surface

explanation.walkthrough: 'Wooden-faced' suggests a deadpan beauty; it is a surface of fine wood, an attractive but superficial show.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin decorative layer of fine wood glued over cheaper material gives furniture a handsome face.
